thesis: The speakers argue that AI coding represents the first truly massive market for AI, potentially worth $3 trillion based on the value generated by 30 million developers and a growing population of non-developers. They contend that this shift disrupts every part of the software development value chain, transforming the developer role from writing code to managing multiple agents and thinking at a higher level.
